title: NumPy: a large array (capped) and a 4-D array
source:
import numpy as np

big = np.arange(500)
big[0] = -1
grid = big.reshape(20, 25)
first = big[:5]
hyper = np.zeros((2, 2, 2, 2))

steps.narration: big now refers to a new ndarray.
grid now refers to a new ndarray.
first now refers to a new ndarray.
hyper now refers to a new ndarray.
